title: Emenegger and Linda Moulton Howe promised footage that is then pulled

tellings.quote: away. Then in the 70s you got Emagger and uh and uh Lyndon Molton Howler and who think they're also going to get footage then it get pulled away.

plain: In the 1970s and 80s, the filmmaker Robert Emenegger and the journalist Linda Moulton Howe were each led to believe they would be given government footage of UFOs, and each time it was pulled away. A guest named Bryce Zabel tells Michels this in passing, without naming a source, as part of a pattern of officials dangling evidence before Hollywood and the press and then taking it back.
